artifacts_produced.deploy_evidence: Read-only measurement script. Runs the real import of lib.research.corpus.dossier_refresh in a clean child process under a builtins.__import__ hook, sizes each third-party distribution from its RECORD file list, names the first lib module that pulls it in, runs a static ast check of lib imports (top level versus inside functions), and runs the positive (lib.research.harvest.store, pyarrow) and negative (json) controls. No source file is edited, no AWS, S3, network or pip call is made.

Stdout of one run of cn4_closure.py from the worktree root: CLOSURE-IMPORTED modules=1043 lib_modules=25 third_party_tops=21; 18 third-party distributions; LAMBDA-CLOSURE total_mb=287.13 against the 250 MB limit, verdict=OVER; both controls as expected.

Two rows appended by byte insertion (45 insertions, 0 deletions): AMGT_HARVST-D1-W181-S1 (the OVER finding and the three largest packages with their pulling lib modules) and AMGT_HARVST-D1-W181-S2 (the pytz importlib._bootstrap attribution and the corrected json control).
